items.title: Goldman Sachs bullish on India, Hong Kong shares in 2027
items.summary: Investing.com-- Goldman Sachs raised India and Hong Kong-listed Chinese shares to Overweight and cut Taiwan and mainland China’s A-shares to Market weight, urging investors to reduce concentration in AI hardware heading into 2027.

items.title: Goldman Sachs starts SBM Offshore at Buy, sees 25% upside on deepwater wave
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs has initiated coverage of SBM Offshore with a "buy" rating, saying the Dutch offshore engineering company is well positioned to benefit from an anticipated wave of deepwater oil and gas investment.

items.title: Hedge Funds Are Dumping Leverage at a Pace Last Seen in March 2020. A 63-Year-Old Who Moved His 401(k) to Cash Then Would Have Missed a 51.5% Rally. Here’s the Math
